info.title: tsundoku API
info.description: Manga discovery service. Read endpoints (`GET`) are public unless `auth.read_requires_auth = true`. Write endpoints (`POST`) always require the admin bearer.

get.summary: Subscribe to manual-trigger lifecycle events as an SSE stream.
get.description:
Auth: inherits the read auth gate (`auth.read_requires_auth`). The
browser `EventSource` API cannot carry a custom `Authorization`
header, so installs that flip `read_requires_auth=true` will need
the operator's `api_key` to be sent via the
`Authorization` header through a fetch-based polyfill, or the gate
disabled for this single route. Default installs (`false`) work out
of the box.

get.summary:
Every genre that's been observed at least once, sorted by descending
series count, then name. Powers the feed-filter autocomplete.
Pings the database and reports `ok` when reachable.

Foreign-id map sizes: `series_external_ids` counts grouped by provider,
plus persisted MangaUpdates legacy → modern slug cache stats. Used by
the admin "ID Maps" page; no range/bucketing applies because these
numbers are not time-series.

get.summary:
List every registered metadata provider with its latest cache-refresh
markers and the active-provider flag.

post.summary:
Fan-out cache refresh for every registered provider. Returns a per-id
triggered/skipped breakdown so the admin UI can render each result.

Trigger an offline-cache refresh for the named provider. Same locking
semantics as the scheduled refresh job; an in-flight refresh causes
this request to report `skipped = true` without spawning a duplicate.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Provider id

404.description: No provider with that id registered

get.summary:
Title-or-externalId search against a single provider. Powers the
review-queue "Link release" modal.
get.description:
- `?externalId=<id>` — direct lookup via `MetadataProvider::get`.
- `?q=<title>` — `MetadataProvider::search`, then enrichment via
  `get` on the top N hits and Dice-rescoring against `q`.
- both empty → `400 Bad Request`.
- unknown `id` → `404 Not Found`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Provider id

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text title query. Trimmed before use; ignored when empty.

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description:
Direct provider external-id lookup. When set, the handler short-
circuits to `MetadataProvider::get` and returns at most one hit
with `score = 1.0`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Maximum number of hits to enrich with full metadata. Defaults to
10; clamped to `[1, 50]` to keep the per-request cost bounded.

400.description: Both q and externalId missing or empty

get.summary: List releases ordered by `observed_at` descending. Filters compose.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Filter by resolution status (`resolved`, `unresolved`, `ambiguous`,
`review_pending`, `rejected`, `standalone`).

post.summary:
Re-run the resolver against every release currently visible in the
review queue (`unresolved`, `ambiguous`, `review_pending`). Spawns a
background task and returns immediately so the request doesn't block
on what can be a multi-minute walk. A dedicated per-process lock
prevents a second click from spawning a parallel walk; in that case
the response is `{ triggered: false, skipped: true }`.

get.summary: Review queue: releases awaiting human attention.
get.description:
Returns releases whose status is `unresolved`, `ambiguous`, or
`review_pending`, each with the recorded review candidates so the UI
can render a "pick the right match" panel without a second fetch.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-indexed page number.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page (capped server-side at 200).

post.summary:
Mark a release as a worthwhile standalone item that is not (and will
never be) a tracked series: a guidebook, an artbook, a one-shot. Drops
candidates and pins the status to `standalone` so the resolver leaves it
alone; unlike `rejected`, these stay browsable in the "Kept" view.
Re-run `retry` to pull one back into the resolution pipeline.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Release id

post.summary: Manually link a release to a series. Body shape:
post.description:
- `{ "seriesId": 42 }` — link to an existing series row by internal id.
- `{ "provider": "mangabaka", "externalId": "1677" }` — link by a
  provider's external id. If no `series_external_ids` row matches yet,
  the active provider's `get` is called to fetch metadata and create
  the series row before linking.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Release id

400.description: Provider not registered or external_id unknown to provider

post.summary:

get.summary: List series ordered by last release timestamp (most recent first by default).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filter by stored `series.type` (e.g. `manga`).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by stored `series.status` (e.g. `ongoing`).

parameters.name: owned
parameters.description: Filter by ownership flag (true = owned by Codex, false = discoverable).

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Filter by a single genre name. AND-combined with the other filters.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter by a single tag name. AND-combined with the other filters.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort field. Supports `last_release_at` (default) and `first_seen_at`.
Ignored when `q` is present (results are ranked by relevance instead).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` or `desc` (default).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-text query. When set, results are ranked by a Dice-coefficient
score against canonical + alternate titles, with a boost for FTS5
prefix matches. Whitespace-only is treated as absent.

get.summary: List every registered discovery source with its last-poll markers.

post.summary:
Fan-out trigger for every registered source. Returns a per-source
triggered/skipped result without aggregating: callers see the same
per-source outcomes a series of single-source calls would have produced.

Trigger an in-process historical backfill for the named source. Runs
the same loop as the `tsundoku backfill` CLI, but inside the serve
process under the shared per-source mutex, so it cannot race a cron
poll (returns `skipped = true` when work is already in flight). Returns
`422` when the source's kind does not support backfill.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Source instance name

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description:
Number of listing pages to walk, starting at page 1. Clamped to a
minimum of 1.

404.description: No source with that name registered

422.description: Source kind does not support historical backfill

post.summary:
Trigger a one-shot poll for the named source. Uses the same per-source
mutex the cron job holds, so a manual kick during a scheduled tick is
silently skipped (`skipped = true`).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Source instance name

404.description: No source with that name registered

get.summary: Aggregate counts surfaced by the frontend home page and review badge.
Tag analog of [`list_genres`]. Same shape, different table.

kind.description:
`None` is stored when a failure row pre-dates the error_kind helper
or comes from an unwrapped legacy path; surface it as `unknown`.

count.description: Number of `(provider, external_id) → series_id` rows recorded.

ExtractedLinksDto.description:
External provider links scraped from a release's description. Mirrors
`td_source::ExternalLinks`; redefined here so we don't pull utoipa into
the domain crate.

externalIds.description:
Per-provider row counts from `series_external_ids`. Sorted
alphabetically by provider for stable rendering.

mangaupdatesRedirectCache.description: State of the persisted MangaUpdates legacy → modern slug cache.

JobEvent.description:
Single broadcast frame for the SSE channel. Always has `kind`, `id`,
`phase`, and `at` (epoch millis); `result` is only populated on
`Finished` events.

JobKind.description:
Kind of work an event refers to. Stays a plain string in the
serialized form so the frontend can pattern-match without importing
the enum.

JobPhase.description:
Lifecycle phase. `Started` fires after the per-key mutex was
acquired (so a `skipped` job emits only `Finished`).

JobResult.description:
Compact result payload attached to a `finished` event. Optional
per-trigger fields (fetched / new / resolved / bytes) are `None`
when the trigger doesn't produce them.

LinkRequest.description:
Body for the manual-link endpoint. Exactly one of:
- `seriesId`: link to an existing series row by internal id.
- `provider` + `externalId`: link via the named provider's external id;
  the provider's `get` is called when no mapping exists yet.

lastResolvedAt.description:
Epoch seconds of the most recent translation. `None` when the
cache is empty.

modernCount.description:
Rows where `modern_id IS NOT NULL` — legacy ids we've successfully
translated to a slug.

tombstoneCount.description:
Rows where `modern_id IS NULL` — legacy ids MU retired, so we no
longer waste a HEAD request on them.

pages.description:
Pages the run was asked to walk (after clamping); it may stop early
if the source runs out of history.

skipped.description:
`true` when a poll or backfill for this source was already in
flight; the request is a no-op.
`false` when a previous tick is still in flight; the request is a no-op.

ProviderConfigDto.description:
Per-provider config exposed to the admin UI. The api_key is reported as
a boolean only; the raw value never leaves the process.

apiKeySet.description:
`true` when an api_key is configured (any non-empty value). The
actual key never appears in JSON; that's the whole point of stashing
it in `.env`.

offlineCacheLoaded.description: Runtime: whether the on-disk dump is currently loaded.

oneOf.description:
Operator-facing snapshot of the `[providers.<id>]` config block. May
be `None` for providers that don't have a typed config block (today
this only happens for test doubles).

ProviderSearchHit.description:
One enriched hit. `score` is Dice(`q`, `title`) for the title-search
path, or `1.0` for the externalId short-circuit path.

nativeTitle.description:
First alternate title, if any. Useful for showing the
romaji/Japanese form alongside the canonical English title.

skipped.description: `false` when a refresh is already in flight; the request is a no-op.
`true` when a prior retry-all batch is still in flight; the request is a no-op.

triggered.description: `true` when a batch was spawned by this request.

alternateTitles.description:
Alternate / native titles persisted on the series row. Surfaced
in the review UI so romaji / Japanese / publisher variants are
visible without opening the provider page.

provider.description:
Provider + external_id pair for building a link to the provider's
page. Prefers the active provider's mapping; falls back to any
other mapping so the operator always has a way to inspect the
candidate. None when the series has no external IDs persisted.

timeToDecisionP50Seconds.description:
Median time (seconds) from observed to resolved, over closures in
`[since, until)`. `null` when nothing closed.

description.description:
Short synopsis. The list UI clamps this to a few lines; the detail
page shows it in full.

SourceConfigDto.description:
Operator-facing snapshot of the per-source config (the bits visible in
`[[sources]]` and any kind-specific nested options). Never carries
secrets; the source layer doesn't have any in v1.

feedUrl.description:
Feed URL for the source kind. Empty when the kind doesn't define one
(every kind today does, so this is informational future-proofing).

maxPages.description:
Maximum number of feed pages walked per poll. Always `1` today:
no v1 source kind paginates inside the steady-state poll. Kept on
the DTO as a placeholder for future paginated source kinds; the
`backfill` CLI is the historical-catch-up path in the meantime.

siteBaseUrl.description: Override for the site base URL. Useful when the feed is proxied.

oneOf.description:
Static config block snapshotted at boot. `None` when a source is in
the registry but its config entry isn't, which today only happens in
tests using a hand-built `SourceRegistry`.

successRate.description:
Convenience derivation: `successCount / (successCount + failureCount)`,
`null` when the denominator is zero. Saves the client from a no-op
division when nothing has run yet.

cleanupRulesApplied.description:
Stable rule names that fired during cleanup (e.g. `strip_parens`,
`split_alternates`). Rendered as badge chips on the review card.

descriptionHtml.description:
Raw description blob (markdown for Nyaa posts that ran detail
fetch; the RSS anchor stub otherwise). The review UI renders this
inline so the operator can decide without opening the post page.

oneOf.description:
External-provider links the source scraped from the description.
`None` when nothing was found; the field is omitted from the
payload via `skip_serializing_if`.

searchQueries.description:
Search queries the title cleaner produced for this release
(longest-first). Empty when the release predates the cleaner or
failed to persist; the next resolve cycle backfills.

oneOf.description:
Convenience pointer to `candidates[0]`, when present. Lets the
card render without defensive-checking the array on every render.
